_about: A model of a workspace's Spark settings. default_pool is "Starter pool" or a custom pool's name. Custom pools have node_size (Small, Medium, Large, X-Large, XX-Large), autoscale, min_nodes, max_nodes and dynamic_executor_allocation. team_pools says which pool each team's work runs on.

needs.Analysts: Interactive notebooks over small data all day. Sessions should start in seconds.
needs.ETL: One nightly job with big joins. Each node needs 16 vCores. It needs 2 nodes on quiet nights and up to 12 on month-end, and should give nodes back afterwards.
needs.DataScience: Several notebooks open at once by the same people; they want them to share one Spark session.
